title: UACR micro-paper image classification: code, image dataset, results, diagnosis application and device design
description: Code accompanying the article on classification of the urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (NORMAL / MICRO / MACRO) from paired paper-based colorimetric images: (i) the image dataset (albumin and creatinine pads), a de-identified label table, a Python notebook that runs the complete analysis and the stored results (feature extraction, five classical machine-learning models, CNNs, sample-grouped nested cross-validation, measurement audit, deployment bundle); (ii) the PyQt5 application of the prototype point-of-care device; (iii) the device design files. Code: MIT; images, label table, results and design files: CC BY 4.0. Research prototype, not a medical device.
